title: Repair a weak song section before full regeneration
summary: Community hypothesis: targeted editing, extensions or reuse of a stronger sibling take may preserve good parts more effectively than changing the whole prompt.

build.target: Preserve successful portions of an original track while testing a targeted fix for a weak section.
requires: Authorized source song and Suno editing/extension tools
Song section boundary or failure region
inputs: Existing Suno clip ID and rights
Specific fault: rushed chorus, missing instrument, poor outro
outputs: A reviewable repair plan with minimal changed region
Provider edit/extension receipts and listening comparison when authorized
execute: Inspect the track and describe one defect with approximate location.
Check available official edit, extension, mashup or source-reference operations and prerequisites.
Prefer the smallest supported operation that can address the defect; document why.
Request authorization for any billable operation, capture original and revised clip IDs.
Compare unchanged sections, audible artifacts and target improvement; retain originals.

applies_when: A track has strong parts worth preserving.
An ending or one section fails while the rest succeeds.
avoid_when: There is no supported targeted editing operation in the current account.
The source material cannot legally be edited or remixed.

operator: No paid retries without bounded budget.
Do not assume source clip permission from its public URL.

stop_when: One narrowly scoped repair is evaluated, or blocked by unavailable rights/feature.
Stop if repeated revisions damage previously correct sections.

checks: Listen to altered and untouched regions to detect unrequested changes.
Link resulting clip IDs and negatives to the original.
